purpose: Verify exact algebraic invariants and constructed counterexamples underlying cross-family Mirror experiment integration. Not a model-performance evaluation, not evidence of novelty, capacity or byte-saving by Mirror.

checks.name: fixed-view fold equality
checks.admissible: invertible Q, componentwise GELU and matching folded biases
checks.negative: pure permutation alone yields no new function

checks.name: RA weighted baseline reachability
checks.admissible: SPD metrics, in-range target b; out-of-range is infinity
checks.negative: reachability ratio does not imply task loss improvement

checks.name: finite-update residual recursion
checks.admissible: fixed Jacobian and fixed SPD preconditioner, local least-squares

checks.name: K>=r+1 rank bound and regular simplex
exact lazy canonical KV read
checks.admissible: known right transforms on shared cached K,V and unchanged prefix hidden state
checks.negative: cannot infer safe sharing across distinct upstream states

checks.name: cross-block PSD coupling majorizer
checks.admissible: symmetric PSD G; diagonal may underestimate

checks.name: actual serializer rounding boundary
checks.admissible: explicit bit serializer overhead and exact hard budget

checks.name: decoded-state quotient requires prerequisites
checks.admissible: decoded semantic state plus future decoder prerequisites

checks.name: constructed joint layout x code vs coordinate descent
checks.admissible: explicit four-state nonseparable table, not natural model evidence

checks.name: activation-weighted error vs raw Frobenius
checks.admissible: fixed linear interface, uncentered second moment; not nonlinear end-to-end proof

checks.name: noncommuting two-step composition
checks.admissible: matrix order and explicit executor; mere residual summation not equivalent

decision.PASS: All F01..F12 exact checks satisfy conditions on each of five locked fresh worlds, and negative controls are flagged; mark algebraic implementation PASS only.
decision.FAIL: Any exact invariant mismatch beyond tolerance, invalid domain labeled valid, wrong budget with serializer, or a constructed counterexample not reproduced.
decision.UNCERTAIN: Ill-conditioned numerical inversion or rank choice reverses result; report relative/absolute err and conditioning. No training/LLM result or Mirror adoption.

uncertainty: Primary exact numerical algebra errors in dimensionless float64; report max absolute/relative error and matrix condition numbers, no simulated statistical CIs. For any measured quality metrics later, u_c=(u_seed²+u_eval²+u_num²)^(1/2) only under independent components and k=2 indicative. No latency/bytes natural performance claim.
audit_integrity: All five frozen seeds run once; no result-based parameter tuning. Validation on constructed counterexamples is mathematical, not empirical task-capacity evidence.
created_files_only: Save source, 3 dev and 5 fresh raw rows, verification JSON with source and data hashes after running. Preserve negative outcomes. No changes to scientific MA status.
